protocol.note: Fit-free CLIP-cache performance exploration. Select original 512D rows; no PCA/training, decoding or CLIP encoding. No raw speedup claim.

metrics.ano_auc_scope: Pooled frames of manifest.is_anomaly videos, including normal intervals

fine_grained.gt_source: Unmodified bundled gt_segment.npy and gt_label.npy; order validated against manifest
fine_grained.comparison_status: Original-code reproduction; agreement with published values still requires measurement

validation_status: execution results only; external reproduction acceptance not automatic
vad_input: original cached 512D feature rows; original dtype/values

source_snapshot.kind: separate source copy, no .git history or large inputs copied

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers

cache_source.feature_hash_scope: current cache bytes; not an assertion of historical bitwise provenance

memory.rss_scope: not sampled; FFmpeg child memory not measured
memory.gpu_scope: whole processing loop after warmup, includes model and visual copy; output saving and GT analysis may be included

timing_scope.included: Candidate construction/selection; cache loading/validation and fit-free projection if cached; raw decoding/preprocess/transfers/CLIP if raw; VadCLIP and timeline restoration
timing_scope.io_condition: Source hash read just before timed processing; file cache uncontrolled and likely warm
timing_scope.concurrency: Not enforced; final timings require an otherwise idle shared machine

reference_comparison.reason: Archived evaluation sources differ. Re-evaluate cached 100% Reference with current code; compare_sampling uses that new Reference.
